title: Madrid vs Barcelona: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Madrid for art, culture, and authenticity. Barcelona for Gaudí, beaches, and the most spectacular architecture in Europe. Do both if you have 7+ days.

categories.name: Architecture
categories.summary: Gaudí's Sagrada Família is one of the world's most extraordinary buildings. Madrid has the Royal Palace and classical architecture.

categories.name: Art Museums
categories.summary: The Prado, Reina Sofía (Guernica), and Thyssen form the world's best art triangle. Barcelona has MNAC and the Picasso Museum.

categories.name: Food & Tapas
categories.summary: Madrid wins for traditional Spanish tapas culture; Barcelona wins for Catalan cuisine and Michelin density.

categories.name: Beach Access
categories.summary: Barcelona has 4.5km of beaches, 15 min by metro. Madrid is 300km from the coast.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Madrid is 12-15% cheaper. Mid-range daily budget: Madrid €80-110, Barcelona €100-130.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Barcelona has world-class clubs (Razzmatazz). Madrid has more authentic bar-hopping culture.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Barcelona has more documented pickpocket issues, especially on La Rambla.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Toledo and Segovia are exceptional UNESCO day trips from Madrid. Barcelona's Montserrat is good but thinner competition.

faq.question: Is Madrid or Barcelona better for a first-time visit?
faq.answer: Barcelona is more iconic (Gaudí); Madrid is more authentic and better for art/culture. Reddit votes Madrid for solo travelers and culture lovers.

faq.question: How far is Madrid from Barcelona?
faq.answer: AVE train: 2.5 hours, €30-70. Fly: 1.5 hours in air but 4-5 hours door-to-door. Train is almost always better.
